title: Audit all onlytools repos for hardcoded ports/URLs, replace with fed slug-based discovery
acceptanceCriteria: grep -r "localhost:[0-9]" across all onlytools repos finds zero hardcoded ports (excluding tests)
grep -r "127.0.0.1:[0-9]" finds zero hardcoded ports (excluding tests)
Each tool has a fed slug in its config
fed discover <slug> returns correct port for each running tool
Tools that previously hardcoded ports now use fed discovery
Does NOT break tools when fed is not running (graceful fallback)
